crossRefs.note: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with…
He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and…

translations.web: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
translations.bsb: Eat honey, my son, for it is good, and the honeycomb is sweet to your taste.
translations.kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
translations.asv: My son, eat thou honey, for it is good; And the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to thy taste:
